description: Extracts the DBA (Doing Business As) name and determines whether the pharmacy is exempt from providing a Certificate of Good Standing.

DBA.description: The DBA (Doing Business As) name or corporation name that appears on the document. This is the legal entity name registered with the Puerto Rico Department of State.

IsExempt.description: In case that the pharmacy is not a corporation, or has a DBA (Doing Business As), then the pharmacy is exempt from providing the Certificate of Good Standing.
